Both primitive cycle counts are combinatorial counts of these explicit classes. value.rationale: The object is the natural cross-polytope skeleton (complete graph minus a perfect matching), and its minimal one-vertex universal extension. At equal time-zero independent binary opinion law, immediate two-cycle probability falls from Theta(n^{-1/2}) to Theta(2^{-n}n^{-1/2}) on adding one hub, while deterministic stabilization remains bounded by two updates. This is a natural sharp parity/robustness phenomenon in symmetric threshold dynamics, not a new notation for the eventual period-two theorem; the formulas give exact finite populations and sharp transient times for infinite graph sequences. No general application outside these families is claimed.
